Chapter 952: Chapter 14: Striking The Ultimate? (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 952: Chapter 14: Striking the Ultimate? (Please Subscribe)

“The incarnation has finally settled down.”

In his homeland universe, within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, Lin Yuan opened his eyes, a smile appearing on his face.

The stronghold of the peak master of the Ruling Realm, Cang Weiyang, brought substantial gains to Lin Yuan, thus he urgently needed a place to digest these gains, and the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent seemed just right.

“First, let the incarnation familiarize itself there, and when it steps into the twelfth level, I’ll bring all the unnecessary resources and treasures for trade,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Without reaching the twelfth level, Lin Yuan dares not let his incarnation carry too valuable treasures out of the universe.

And trading… compared to killing for treasure, Lin Yuan preferred fair trade, as it was safest.

Lin Yuan is not one of those at the twelfth level of the Path Splitting Realm with an uncertain future; with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, what he lacks the most is a safe environment for growth.

…

“The world within me now…”

Lin Yuan sent a sliver of consciousness into his inner world.

Compared to a hundred years ago, his internal world has now expanded several times, reaching an astonishing eleven light-years in range.

Eleven light-years in range… compared to the ordinary Level Eleven Perfect life’s tens of millions to hundreds of millions of light-years, Lin Yuan’s internal world is billions of times theirs.

“My current internal world, physical body, soul, etc., have all reached their limits; I’ve nearly absorbed all the transformations brought by the Chaos Rule,”

Lin Yuan thought.

Despite having deduced the Chaos Rule, it’s ultimately incomparable to the essential leap of life; the absorption and immersion of the Chaos Void Origin energy in his internal world is ultimately limited.

“Even in the boundless Chaos Void, I must be among the strongest of the eleventh level, right?”

Lin Yuan felt the vast and immeasurable energy within him and thought.

Lin Yuan was unclear about the era the Chaos Void was currently in, but in the era of Xuanhuang and the Moyu Tower Master, he had never heard of anyone at the eleventh level stronger than himself.

Indeed.

The Chaos Void has countless opportunities.

Instances have occurred where eleven level lives challenged those at the twelfth level.

These were always through the aid of various external forces and factors. Compared to them, Lin Yuan, who solely relied on himself to reach a level comparable or even superior to the usual Path Splitting Realm… It’s not an exaggeration to consider him unique in the Chaos Void.

“In these hundred years, the pathway of the twelfth level of the Martial Tao has been almost perfected,” Lin Yuan’s thoughts fluctuated.

To strive for the ultimate and step into the twelfth level of the Path Splitting Realm, one naturally needs to perfect it.

Actually, as early as a hundred years ago, Lin Yuan had already perfected the initial phase of this realm. Even then, stepping directly into the twelfth level would not have been a problem.

But while waiting for his own transformation, Lin Yuan took the opportunity to perfect the entire realm.

“Before challenging the ultimate, first see if I can pass the eighth floor of the Black Tower,” Lin Yuan was moved.

A hundred years ago, Lin Yuan easily passed through the seventh floor of the Black Tower but stopped at the final stretch of the eighth floor.

At that time, Lin Yuan realized the deficiency in his life essence.

After all, he was only a level eleven life.

But now?

As his internal world explosively expanded several times over, Lin Yuan’s life essence naturally rose significantly as well.

Even though still not comparable to the life of the Ruling Realm, having deduced the Chaos Rule, he surpassed most of the peak masters of the Ruling Realm.

Thinking this, Lin Yuan directly descended into the Demon Jade Space.

The rules set by the Moyu Tower Master dictated that rewards obtained by tower challengers depended on their performance during the climb.

Therefore.

If Lin Yuan chose to pass the eighth floor at the eleventh level, the benefits he’d receive would naturally be much greater than doing so after stepping into the twelfth level.

Even for a twelfth level of the Path Splitting Realm to pass the eighth floor, it’s extremely against-heaven.

The Demon Jade Space.

The nine-floored Black Tower.

Lin Yuan’s figure descended.

“You’ve come.” The Statue Shen Ji came out, his gaze towards Lin Yuan filled with emotions.

He had never imagined that he would encounter such an abnormal monster.

Compared to Lin Yuan, even being a Chaos Great Saint like the Moyu Tower Master seems… average?

“I’ll try the eighth floor.”

Lin Yuan spoke in a gentle tone.

“Okay.”

The Statue Shen Ji nodded.

He then cleared the path leading to the eighth floor of the Black Tower.

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan entered the eighth floor of the Black Tower.

The Statue Shen Ji immediately began to observe.

This time in the eighth floor, Lin Yuan didn’t hesitate and directly utilized the Chaos Qi to strengthen himself.

He arrived at the final stage of the eighth floor.

“Break for me!”

Lin Yuan lowly shouted, his greatly increased life essence finally allowed him to cross over and step into the ‘end’ of the eighth floor.

“Passed.”

Lin Yuan felt a slight relief in his heart.

At this moment, he had reached his own limit state; if he couldn’t pass the eighth floor of the Black Tower now, he’d probably have to wait until he stepped into the twelfth level of the Path Splitting Realm to try again.

“Congratulations… you are the one hundred forty-second member of my Demon Jade Tower to pass the eighth floor…” The Statue Shen Ji appeared and spoke.

“The one hundred forty-second?” Lin Yuan was slightly stunned.

Only one hundred forty-two?

“It’s quite a lot already,” The Statue Shen Ji sighed.

Those who can pass the eighth floor of the Black Tower are generally at the peak of the Ruling Realm.

In its heyday, the Demon Jade Tower had one hundred forty-one peak Ruling Realm masters, along with several Chaos Realm beings, and seated with the Chaos Great Saint as the Moyu Tower Master, it was considered extremely strong.

In reality, by the Chaos Realm, very few would submit to any Chaos Great Saint. Chaos Venerables could completely establish a Chaos Continent of their own, roaming freely; why follow a Chaos Great Saint?

Protection?

With the strength of a Chaos Venerable, it’s hard to die as long as one doesn’t court death.

Even a Chaos Great Saint would find it very difficult to completely kill a Chaos Venerable.

The numerous life-saving methods of a Chaos Venerable should not be underestimated.

Guidance?

From a Chaos Venerable to a Chaos Great Saint… one can only rely on oneself. Seeking refuge with a Chaos Great Saint hardly aids one’s own breakthrough into the Great Saint’s Domain.

The Chaos Dragon Beast subdued by Ancient Ming Venerable in the Chaos Continent of Ancient Ming only compares closely to a Chaos Venerable, not equivalent to one.

“That’s quite a lot.”

Lin Yuan thought for a moment and still felt he had underestimated himself.

Now, setting other aspects aside, he is already above the vast majority of the pinnacle masters in the domain of rules.

Even during the peak period of the Magic Jade Tower, he could be ranked within the top two hundred.

“This is the reward list for passing the eighth level.” Statue Shen Ji waved his hand, and a light screen appeared in front of Lin Yuan.

The list enumerated treasures from the Chaos Realm of the highest order.

Normally, the rewards for passing the eighth level of the Black Tower are supreme treasures of the master realm, with occasionally one or two Chaos Realm treasures.

But Lin Yuan passed as a Level Eleven, and now the treasures listed by the Statue Shen Ji are the most precious batch in the entire nine-story Black Tower.

Normal members of the Magic Jade Tower, even if they surpass the ninth level, won’t get to choose these treasures.

Only those Chaos Venerables who pass the ninth level with a particularly Against-Heaven’s demeanour and have hopes of becoming Chaos Great Saints, get the treatment that Lin Yuan has now merely by passing the eighth level.

“So many treasures…”

Lin Yuan was inwardly shocked. The Chaos Realm secret treasure left by the peak master ‘Cang Weiyang’ didn’t even qualify to be at the bottom of this reward list.

For Chaos Venerables, Chaos Realm secret treasures are not considered precious; many of them are simply crafted by Chaos Venerables casually.

Otherwise, ‘Cang Weiyang’ wouldn’t have had three Chaos Realm secret treasures on him.

Of course, for those in the Path Splitting and master realms, a Chaos Realm secret treasure weapon is still extremely precious.

“Which one should I choose?”

Lin Yuan was somewhat troubled for a moment.

First, eliminate the weapon secret treasures. The weapon secret treasures on the reward list are all top-tier Chaos Realm weapon secret treasures, which, even if Lin Yuan advances to Level Twelve, he wouldn’t be able to refine and wield for a long time.

Unable to refine or use, no matter how precious, they’re somewhat impractical.

“Forget it, I’ll choose when I step into Level Twelve.”

Lin Yuan thought for a moment, currently being only Level Eleven, if he rushed a choice and it ended up not being useful once reaching Level Twelve, it would be a loss.

Anyway, he is not lacking anything at the moment, so there’s no need to make an immediate choice.

“I’ll wait and choose later.”

Lin Yuan looked towards Statue Shen Ji and spoke.

“No problem.” Statue Shen Ji nodded.

“Next, I want to check out the ninth level.” Lin Yuan raised his head looking towards the ninth level of the Black Tower.

This is also the final level of the Black Tower; passing the ninth level generally means one possesses the peak strength of the Chaos Realm, not far from becoming a Chaos Great Saint.

“Go ahead.”

Statue Shen Ji showed a slightly strange expression but still nodded.

The next moment.

Lin Yuan arrived at the ninth level of the Black Tower.

There were no pressures here, nor any rule tests.

The entire ninth level was empty, nothing at all, which surprised Lin Yuan.

“What’s the standard for passing the ninth level?”

Lin Yuan pondered in his heart, as there was nothing resembling a ‘finish line’ nearby.

Just then.

The whole ninth level suddenly dimmed.

A majestic figure condensed.

He was dressed in a black robe, his gaze indifferent, seemingly embodying the principles of the Dao.

“This?”

Lin Yuan’s expression changed as he met this majestic figure’s gaze, then felt his consciousness fall, and when he recovered, he was outside the nine-level Black Tower.

“The ninth level is?”

Lin Yuan’s expression became solemn.

“Correct.”

“To pass the ninth level, you must defeat an imprint left by the original owner.” Statue Shen Ji said next to him.

“An imprint left by the Moyu Tower Master?” Lin Yuan was quite speechless.

He knew that the ninth level of the Black Tower was difficult but didn’t expect it to be this challenging. The Moyu Tower Master was a Chaos Great Saint, and his imprint was not something an ordinary Chaos Realm could handle.

After all, the powerhouses appearing in the Demon Jade Space are just incarnations of a sliver of mental consciousness.

…

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan reopened his eyes.

“Now it seems, the strength of the Moyu Tower Master shouldn’t be weaker than Xuanhuang…” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Previously, watching Xuanhuang open up 33,333 Xuanhuang Secret Realms, Lin Yuan felt that Xuanhuang was stronger than the Moyu Tower Master.

“Let’s not worry about these…” Lin Yuan collected his thoughts and gazed into the Cosmic Starry Skies.

For the past century, Lin Yuan’s two Primordial Spirits and Incarnation have been wandering around the universe, often sensing causal lockdown espionage from alien races of Level Twelve.

Unfortunately, those Level Twelve alien races are not stronger than Lin Yuan in comprehending the causal rules, so even though Lin Yuan gives them opportunities, actively letting out his two Primordial Spirits and Incarnation.

The alien races of Level Twelve couldn’t lock down the positions of the two Primordial Spirits and Incarnation, let alone attempt an assassination.

“I’ve given you all the opportunities, but they’re not useful…”

Lin Yuan sighed, at this moment his various aspects have reached their peak, ready to strike at the ultimate at any time.
